contract: Compare the active AVC SPS/PPS and HEVC VPS/SPS/PPS in source order. Retain and compare original parameter-set bytes, the revision and cropped dimensions. An AVC parameter-set ID is reused with a changed raster and timing.

Compare the raw SPS timing fields through the pinned FFmpeg trace_headers interface independently of its frame-rate projection. Exercise timing absent and present, both AVC fixed-rate flags, and both HEVC POC proportionality flags including a physically present interval.

Use H.264 (08/2024) §§7.3.2.1.1, 7.4.2.1.1, E.1.1 and E.2.1 and H.265 (04/2013) §§7.3.2.2, 7.4.3.2, E.2.1 and E.3.1. Compare the HEVC initial slice's PPS, random access and sequence reorder depth through the startup chain.

open_unmeasured.cause: The SPS syntax comparison does not time a corresponding workload.
The SPS syntax comparison does not measure the two heaps.
The SPS syntax comparison does not measure the two processes' resident memory.
